newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.715 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 5.715 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended April 24 was 5,715,115 gallons compared with 4,835,395 gallons last week.
Imports were 298,323 gallons compared with 494,377 gallons the previous week. There were 3,695 domestic receipts for this week compared with 137,216 the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,104,873 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,067,623 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 111,768,919 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 199,824,799 gallons.
